title: Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: When Microsoft reported killer fourth-quarter earnings for its fiscal 2026 year (which ended June 30), it tucked in an interesting little tidbit about how its investments in the tw...
body:
Microsoft recently unveiled its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings, offering a rare glimpse into the contrasting financial performance of its significant AI investments. The tech giant reported a substantial $3.2 billion gain from its stake in Anthropic for the quarter, a notable boost to its diluted earnings per share. In contrast, Microsoft marked down its investment in OpenAI by approximately $600 million during the same period. However, looking at the full fiscal year, Microsoft's OpenAI investment still generated a robust $5 billion gain, underscoring the long-term value despite quarterly fluctuations.

The $5 billion investment in Anthropic, initiated in November 2025, is part of a strategic alliance where Anthropic committed to purchasing $30 billion in Azure services. This arrangement highlights a symbiotic relationship, where Microsoft's capital injection is tied to future cloud consumption, directly contributing to the rapid appreciation of its Anthropic stake. While Microsoft holds about 27% of OpenAI and benefits from revenue-share agreements, its quarterly reporting focuses on investment valuation, which saw a temporary dip despite the overall yearly positive trend.

For developers and researchers, these financial disclosures offer crucial insights into the strategic health and competitive dynamics of the AI landscape. Microsoft's substantial backing of both Anthropic and OpenAI ensures continued access to cutting-edge models, robust cloud infrastructure, and ongoing innovation within the Azure ecosystem. The differing quarterly performances, particularly Anthropic's rapid appreciation, signal the perceived market momentum and strategic importance of these AI labs, influencing where future resources and development efforts might be concentrated. This financial interplay ultimately shapes the tools, platforms, and opportunities available to the broader AI community.
